verdict.rationale: AWS documents hosting agents in production via Bedrock AgentCore and running code on Lambda without managing servers, which implies agents and code can run unattended on the platform. The evidence never explicitly describes setting up background automations with triggers or recurring schedules. Budget auto-actions are a narrow cost guardrail, and CLI scripting is user-run, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/event-trigger mechanisms, explicit background or unattended execution docs, step-by-step automation setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Accelerate agents to production with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, the end-to-end platform to build, connect and optimize highly capable agents securely, at scale
The same code that runs on your laptop can deploy to production with security built into the platform.
Run code without thinking about servers
